notes: On 10 March 2024, an unidentified armed group numbering six abducted a Chinese national from a guest house around Eyenkorin in Ilorin (Ilorin West, Kwara) where he was lodged. The police claimed to have arrested three suspects in connection with the abduction. The abductee was rescued on 19 March by operatives of the state police command (there are no further details on ransom payment or a clash).

Around 27 October 2023 (as reported), an unidentified armed group abducted a soldier (presumed to be off duty) at the Akparata axis of Effium (Ohaukwu, Ebonyi). The soldier was part of the contingent deployed to manage inter-communal clashes in the area. The State government issued an ultimatum to the warring communities to provide the soldier alive by 26 October 2023.
